status: Local candidate; full release acceptance pending

ported.order: Increment vertical velocity before integrating height
ported.roof: Apply terrain delta to the flight plane and its negation to local height; world-space vertical position remains on the same parabola
ported.saveCompatibility: Only pre-existing saved shots without a flight field finish the legacy sine trajectory. Every newly emitted lob, including catapult basketballs, has physical flight state.
ported.collisionSampling: Prior integer projectile draw X, as sampled before UpdateMotion assigns mX/mY.
ported.horizontalOverlap: Board::GetRectOverlap ignores Y. Lob rising/falling/height rules gate direct collision; splash uses horizontal projectile/zombie overlap and row deviation only.
ported.plantCollision: Basketball requires strictly more than 8 horizontal pixels of overlap with Plant::GetPlantRect (regular width 60; tallnut 80; cob cannon 140).
ported.basketballLayers: TOPPLANT_CATAPULT_ORDER: regular plant, then pumpkin, then supporting pot/lily pad in this model; airborne exclusion retained.

rendering.note: Reuse existing projectile textures at native logical dimensions and source draw scales. No claim of measured CPU, process memory or physical-phone performance.
rendering.scaleCorrection: Corrected against the complete Projectile::Draw weapon switch; earlier cabbage .8 / kernel 1 / butter 1 were inaccurate.

remaining: Full zombie rectangle offsets, body altitude, water clipping and reflection still use the model's body-center convention, not a proven complete native-coordinate mapping.
Basketball muzzle and aim coordinates still need the complete catapult native-coordinate mapping.
Full gameplay regression acceptance and browser visual verification must pass before WorkBuddy publication.
Physical iOS and Android verification remains outstanding.
